items.title: Derrick Henry cleared after concussion evaluation

items.title: Broncos, TV legend Tom Jackson dies at 75
items.text: Tom Jackson, a 14-year veteran with the Broncos and a longtime fixture on ESPN's NFL programming, has died.

items.text: The Broncos got out to a 17-0 lead, but the Raiders have settled in after a rough start to narrow that advantage to 17-10 at halftime.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza throws first touchdown pass, Raiders trail Broncos 17-10
items.text: Fernando Mendoza ran it into the end zone for his first professional touchdown last week.

items.title: Jets lead Chargers 17-10 at halftime
items.text: The Jets didn't score a touchdown in Weeks 9 or 10, but they doubled down on them in the first half of their Week 11 game against the Chargers.

items.title: Officials give Jameis Winston a TD, replays appear to show he was down before scoring
items.text: The officials gave Giants quarterback Jameis Winston a touchdown on a fourth-and-goal tush push today against the Jaguars, but on replay it's not at all clear that Winston actually scored.
